_comment: Independent detect.c:dosearch0(1) witness. Use the debug level/floor tools to create an unseen statue trap on the current square, then activate intrinsic Searching with a wished ring, step off the trap, and wait in range. The movement-loop caller should reveal the adjacent trap by automatic search; this does not use the explicit s command or step onto the trap.
